response: Tom Homan appeared on The Charlie Kirk Show this Tuesday and refused to rule out immigration enforcement at polling places while attacking Democrats for what he claims they're afraid of. This is a clear escalation in efforts to intimidate and disenfranchise immigrant communities and people of color, weaponizing borders and so-called sovereignty to preserve systems of inequality that have long excluded vulnerable groups from full democratic participation. Rather than addressing structural discrimination or pushing real institutional reform, this kind of hardline stance reveals a priority on control and exclusion, undermining the rights of those already marginalized by historical injustice. Progressive resistance to these tactics is vital to safeguard fair access to voting and protect against ongoing discrimination that threatens labor rights and social equity for all.
